facts.fact: The Lagos State Ministry of Health reports the EMR platform deployed in 100 of the state's 326 primary health care facilities (Lagos State only, not a national figure), per the Lagos State Primary Health Care Board at a review workshop on 22 May 2025.
facts.system: Talamus EMR platform (Lagos PHC Digitization Project)

facts.fact: The EMR is in use in primary health care centres in Lagos State (100 of 326 PHCs), with Coker Aguda PHC described as fully digitalised end to end; the document does not state that hospitals use it.
facts.system: Talamus EMR platform (Lagos PHC Digitization Project)

facts.fact: The Permanent Secretary of the Lagos State Primary Health Care Board says the EMR in 100 PHCs is giving improved coordination and data integrity 'at the point of care', and Coker Aguda PHC reports patients served from reception to treatment on the digital system.
facts.system: Talamus EMR platform (Lagos PHC Digitization Project)

facts.fact: The Lagos PHC Digitization Project is run by the Lagos State Primary Health Care Board, a state government body, in collaboration with the Clinton Health Access Initiative.
facts.system: Talamus EMR platform (Lagos PHC Digitization Project)

facts.fact: The project is supported by the Gates Foundation through CHAI; the Special Adviser on Health lists a dedicated digital health budget line as a policy priority still to be institutionalised, so that EMRs are 'no longer donor-dependent pilots'.
facts.system: Talamus EMR platform (Lagos PHC Digitization Project)

facts.fact: The chairman of Ojodu Local Council Development Area (Lagos) says the pilot phase of a Local Electronic Medical Records system has begun at Ogba PHC, with the intention of covering the area's primary health centres.
facts.system: Local Electronic Medical Records (LEMR), Ojodu LCDA
